annotations.title: Cruise Cost Calculator: The True Cost of a Cruise, Compared

description: All prices are the caller’s own: the tool holds no cruise fares, gratuity rates, package prices or inclusions, and the defaults are an illustrative example, not quotes. Per option: fare × guests, plus each add-on (per person, per person per night or per booking as described) unless listed in Included, less onboard credit capped at the onboard spend. Returns totals, per person and per person per night, and differences against the cheaper option per person per night. The page compares up to three options. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/cruise-true-cost-calculator

optionADining.description: Option A: speciality dining, per person, for the cruise.

optionADrinks.description: Option A: drinks package or bar spend, per person per night.

optionAExcursions.description: Option A: shore excursions, per person, for the cruise.

optionAFare.description: Option A: cruise fare per person.

optionAFlights.description: Option A: flights and transfers, per person, for the cruise.

optionAGratuities.description: Option A: gratuities and service charges, per person per night (or a percentage of the fare, up to 50, when the gratuity basis is percent).

optionAGratuityBasis.description: Option A: pppn (per person per night) or percent (of the fare).

optionAIncluded.description: Option A: items included in the fare (zeroed), as letters: t = port taxes and fees, g = gratuities and service charges, d = drinks package or bar spend, s = speciality dining, w = wi-fi, x = shore excursions, f = flights and transfers, i = travel insurance. Empty = none.

optionAInsurance.description: Option A: travel insurance, per person, for the cruise.

optionALabel.description: Option A: a short name, e.g. "All-inclusive".

optionAOnboardCredit.description: Option A: onboard credit for the whole booking, deducted up to the onboard spend (gratuities, drinks, dining, Wi-Fi, excursions).

optionAOther.description: Option A: other, for the whole booking.
